summary.text: Elizabeth Wilson is a Democratic state representative for Iowa House District 73 and has served in the Iowa House since 2023.

paragraphs.text: The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Wilson as a small business owner, born in 1964 in Manchester, raised in Center Point and living in Marion, with a bachelor's degree from Cornell College and a master's degree from the University of Iowa.
It lists Wilson as a past director of the Linn-Mar School Board and treasurer of Families Helping Families of Iowa and of Systems Unlimited.
